summary.text: Shane Kampeter is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 60, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a member of the Jefferson City Council representing Ward 5, an office he assumed on April 21, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Kampeter won the Jefferson City Council Ward 5 seat in the nonpartisan election of April 8, 2025, succeeding Mark Schwartz.
In the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for House District 60, he defeated Scott Spencer and Kyerra Johnson-Massey, receiving 3,117 votes, or 49.3 percent.
